scope: Independent documentation, workflow, archive-completeness and operational-claim review. Code tests and physical validation have distinct scopes.

findings.finding: Reproduction omitted npm ci and explicit venv activation.
findings.resolution: README/RUNBOOK now install locks and local package, activate Python3.12 and install npm assets before checks.

findings.finding: Lock installation alone does not install the local package, and inference-only dependencies cannot execute notebooks/reports.
findings.resolution: Document inference versus development environments and explicit python -m pip install --no-deps -e .

findings.finding: The exact Python closure is Linux x86_64; full native Windows/macOS and a physical WSL machine were not executed.
findings.resolution: State observed platform and distinguish Node application use from Linux/WSL Python development.

findings.finding: Industrial subject matter and completed software do not establish production qualification.
findings.resolution: Make the human-review prototype scope and measured misses prominent.

findings.finding: Frozen model flags11/57 defects, misses46, and flags20/21 normals after+30% brightness.
findings.resolution: Do not use for automatic acceptance/rejection; representative target-line data and substantially stronger validated performance remain necessary.

findings.finding: Physical hardware, optics, motion, line speeds and long-duration end-to-end throughput have not been tested.
findings.resolution: Separate serial sampled-camera behavior, model-call time, processing time, source timestamp and physical exposure-to-result latency.

findings.finding: Both saved release ZIPs passed CRC with37 required files and18 tracked examples; complete had342 images,57 masks and source license/readme.
findings.resolution: Recheck regenerated archives after all audit code changes; exclude caches, dependencies, hosting/Git metadata and temporary files.

findings.finding: Code authorship differs from dataset/runtime rights.
findings.resolution: Keep MIT original-code ownership, MVTec CC BY-NC-SA4.0 notices and bundled dependency licenses; add @noble/hashes MIT notice.

findings.finding: An exact calibration tie crosses the threshold between PyTorch runtimes.
findings.resolution: Retain strict failed status, calibration1/test0 decision changes, frozen threshold and unchanged frozen ONNX inference path.

findings.finding: A finite review/test suite does not cover every possible input, browser, hardware or operating scenario.
findings.resolution: Publish observed tests and exclusions; avoid complete edge-coverage or zero-bug guarantees.

findings.finding: The pinned ONNX Runtime Web npm package omitted LICENSE and ThirdPartyNotices files, so a best-effort optional copy did not ship the upstream notices.
findings.resolution: Check in unmodified official v1.23.2 LICENSE and complete ThirdPartyNotices with source URLs/byte hashes, require static build copies, and retain noble/hashes MIT license.

findings.finding: The new development-venv tutorial used .venv-dev, while the original ignore rule only covered .venv; older CLI examples wrote result files outside ignored scratch.
findings.resolution: Ignore .venv-* environments, write tutorial inspection outputs under tmp, and include development-venv/tmp paths in Git publication exclusion checks.

existing_release_archive_checks.scope: Delivered pre-audit archive snapshot, not final regenerated archive counts.

camera_timing_contract.scheduling: serial; delay after completed inspection; no queue
camera_timing_contract.processing_ms: animation-frame wait+preprocess+ORT+residual/scoring; excludes file decode and final DOM paint

unknown_coverage: Physical camera hardware, optics, motion and target-line throughput
Full native Windows/macOS Python dependency installation and a particular WSL machine
Long-duration resource behavior and high-rate capture
Factory generalization, drift and industrial acceptance criteria

Native operating-system file picker was not reverified in the cloud browser; actual File objects are covered by VM lifecycle tests and gallery PNG decoding is observed in the browser, but arbitrary uploaded codec combinations remain bounded coverage.
completion_gate: Completed documentation checks and final software evidence integration. Final generated documents and archive validation are recorded separately after rendering/packaging.

command_entrypoint_environment.method: Separate venv; editable --no-deps --no-build-isolation project install; dependencies supplied externally and no src entry in PYTHONPATH.
command_entrypoint_environment.scope: Importability, help/invalid-option behavior and actual tracked-sample CLI inference; not a fresh full lock install or native Windows execution.
